note: 영문 원본(v1.4a) 14쪽 「Crafting」 — 원문 그대로(오역 고침 · 용어 바꿈 없음). 재료(Apricorn 그림 ×2 · ×3)는 그림이라 글로 옮기지 않았다(제작 레시피는 「설명서 글 ②」의 확장 장).
title: Crafting

blocks.p: During your turn and whilst outside of battle, you may craft items from the Apricorns you have collected on your journey so far.
Required for catching Pokémon [[pokemon.capture|see Capturing Pokémon]].

blocks.caption: Poké Ball · Greater Ball · Ultimate Ball · Keystone Ball

head: Ball
Effect
rows: Roll 3 dice when rolling to capture.
Roll 4 dice when rolling to capture.
Roll 5 dice when rolling to capture.
Roll 6 dice when rolling to capture.

blocks.p: Instant effect. Each type of stew can only be crafted once per turn.

blocks.caption: Restoring Stew · Alluring Stew · Zesty Stew · Infused Stew

head: Stew
Effect
rows: Replace any 1 status symbol with 1 regular hit once during your next wild encounter.
Move 3 additional tiles this turn whilst preventing Alpha Pokémon from battling you.
Discard only half of the Journey Points needed to evolve 1 Pokémon this turn, rounded down.

blocks.p: Attach to a Pokémon in your party. All held items other than Alpha Pokémon tokens can be moved around your team whilst outside of battle.

blocks.caption: Blast Crystal · Star Shield · Lucky Egg · Eviolite · Swiftness Sash · Choice Band

head: Item
Effect
rows: Only on the first attack against the user, deal 1 damage to the attacker and prevent them from switching out this turn.
Only on the first attack against the user, the user takes 2 less damage and is immune to any status effects inflicted this turn.
When the user attacks, replace 2 status symbols with 1 critical hit if possible.
When the user is attacked, remove 2 regular hits. Only works on Weak/Moderate Pokémon or Pokémon that are not fully evolved.
Increase the initiative of the user by 2 but decrease the attack strength of your moves by 1. Minimum 1 attack strength.
Increase the attack strength of a move by 1, but the user may only use this move until switched out.
